scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
